reception: External reception is quieter than the project's internal use: a sizable share of the citing record is StreamIt's own papers and theses, and most outside citations name the work in passing when listing the compiler's optimizations. The clearest line of uptake runs through sketching — Solar-Lezama's StreamBit takes the linear framework as its point of departure, and programming by sketching for bit-streaming programs carries that agenda forward — while the static-analysis community, in Feret's analysis of digital filters and Monniaux's compositional analysis of floating-point linear filters, cites it when treating linear filters as objects of formal study; Sigma* sets its own approach apart from this compile-time analysis.
